title: The Peasant Wedding
source: Kunsthistorisches Museum, Vienna (public domain: Bruegel died in 1569). Wikimedia Commons: The Peasant Wedding (Bruegel).jpg, 43283x29567, saved at 8000 px.
caption: Everyone is at this wedding except, maybe, the groom. Can you find him? #art #arthistory #painting #history #oilpainting
_verify: VERIFIED 2026-10-10 (Wikipedia 'The Peasant Wedding', KHM): 1567, oil on panel 114 x 164 cm, Kunsthistorisches Museum Vienna; bride in front of the green hanging with a paper crown above her; groom's identity debated (man pouring, man passing plates, others), Van der Elst: the groom is absent; plates carried on a door off its hinges; bread, porridge and soup; two pipers; small boy licking a plate in the foreground; wealthy man on the far right talking to a Franciscan friar; sheaves of grain and a rake; an extra 'third foot' under the tray, removed by Pieter Brueghel the Younger in his copy.
Date of the Younger's copy given as 1620 by Wikipedia; slides don't give the year.
'One piper seems to stare at the food' is our reading of the picture.
Focus boxes set on Alex's 1280x885 image 2026-10-10, checked again on the 8000 px Commons image 2026-10-12 (slide 4 widened to show all the feet under the door).

slides.headline: Everyone came to this wedding. Can you find the groom?
slides.sub: Pieter Bruegel the Elder, The Peasant Wedding, 1567

slides.headline: It's her big day
slides.text: Flanders, 1567. The bride sits before a green cloth, a paper crown above her, eyes half closed.

slides.headline: But where is the groom?
slides.text: Is he the man pouring beer? The one passing plates? Some say he never showed up.

slides.headline: While they wonder, dinner arrives
slides.text: Two men carry the plates on a door taken off its hinges. Porridge and soup for everyone.

slides.headline: Look under that door
slides.text: Count the feet. There's one too many. When Bruegel's son copied the painting, he quietly removed it.

slides.headline: Down on the floor
slides.text: The smallest guest has already finished. A boy in a huge red hat licks his plate clean.

slides.headline: Behind him, the music
slides.text: Two bagpipers play on, and one of them can't take his eyes off the food going by.

slides.headline: Not everyone belongs here
slides.text: Far right, a wealthy man in fine clothes chats with a friar. At a peasant wedding.

slides.headline: And tomorrow?
slides.text: Grain and a rake hang on the wall: the harvest is waiting. So, who do you think is the groom?
